lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਹਸਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: anadin sahasaa kade na chookai bin sabadai dukh paae ||
lines.translation: Night and day, his doubts never stop; without the Word of the Shabad, he suffers in pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਬਲਾ ਨਿਤ ਧੰਧਾ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh a(n)tar sabalaa nit dha(n)dhaa karat vihaae ||
lines.translation: Sexual desire, anger and greed are so powerful within him; he passes his life constantly entangled in worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਰਣ ਕਰ ਦੇਖਤ ਸੁਣਿ ਥਕੇ ਦਿਹ ਮੁਕੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: charan kar dekhat sun thake dih muke neRai aae ||
lines.translation: His feet, hands, eyes and ears are exhausted; his days are numbered, and his death is immanent.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਮੀਠਾ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa naam na lago meethaa jit naam nav nidh paae ||
lines.translation: The True Name does not seem sweet to him - the Name by which the nine treasures are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਮਰੈ ਫੁਨਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਤਾਂ ਮੋਖੰਤਰੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevat marai marai phun jeevai taa(n) mokha(n)tar paae ||
lines.translation: But if he remains dead while yet alive, then by so dying, he truly lives; thus, he attains liberation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਪਰਾਣੀ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhur karam na paaio paraanee vin karamaa kiaa paae ||
lines.translation: But if he is not blessed with such pre-ordained karma, then without this karma, what can he obtain?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਤੂ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kaa sabad samaal too mooRe gat mat sabade paae ||
lines.translation: Meditate in remembrance on the Word of the Guru's Shabad, you fool; through the Shabad, you shall obtain salvation and wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਦ ਹੀ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਂ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak satigur tad hee paae jaa(n) vichahu aap gavaae ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he alone finds the True Guru, who eliminates self-conceit from within. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਉ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਗਲੈ ਦਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis dai chit vasiaa meraa suaamee tis no kiu a(n)desaa kisai galai daa loReeai ||
lines.translation: One whose consciousness is filled with my Lord Master - why should he feel anxious about anything?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਗਲਾ ਕਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਧਿਆਇਦਿਆ ਕਿਵ ਨਿਮਖ ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sukhadaataa sabhanaa galaa kaa tis no dhiaaidiaa kiv nimakh ghaRee muhu moReeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the Giver of Peace, the Lord of all things; why would we turn our faces away from His meditation, even for a moment, or an instant?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਹੋਏ ਨਿਤ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੀਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin har dhiaaiaa tis no sarab kaliaan hoe nit sa(n)t janaa kee sa(n)gat jaai baheeai muhu joReeai ||
lines.translation: One who meditates on the Lord obtains all pleasures and comforts; let us go each and every day, to sit in the Saints' Society.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਭੁਖ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਨ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh dukh bhukh rog gae har sevak ke sabh jan ke ba(n)dhan toReeai ||
lines.translation: All the pain, hunger, and disease of the Lord's servant are eradicated; the bonds of the humble beings are torn away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਡਿਠੈ ਜਗਤੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: har kirapaa te hoaa har bhagat har bhagat janaa kai muhi dithai jagat tariaa sabh loReeai ||4||
lines.translation: By the Lord's Grace, one becomes the Lord's devotee; beholding the face of the Lord's humble devotee, the whole world is saved and carried across. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਉ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa suaau na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Let that tongue, which has not tasted the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਸਾਇ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak rasanaa sabad rasaai jin har har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one whose mind is filled with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har - his tongue savors the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਰਸਨਾ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: saa rasanaa jal jaau jin har kaa naau visaariaa ||
lines.translation: Let that tongue, which has forgotten the Name of the Lord, be burnt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh rasanaa har japai har kai naai piaariaa ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the tongue of the Gurmukh chants the Lord's Name, and loves the Name of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape thaakur sevak bhagat har aape kare karaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Master, the servant and the devotee; the Lord Himself is the Cause of causes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape vekhai vigasai aape jit bhaavai tit laae ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself beholds, and He Himself rejoices. As He wills, so does He enjoin us.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਉਝੜਿ ਪਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ikanaa maarag paae aape har ikanaa ujhaR paae ||
lines.translation: The Lord places some on the Path, and the Lord leads others into the wilderness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤਪਾਵਸੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਚਲਤ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sachaa saahib sach tapaavas kar vekhai chalat sabaae ||
lines.translation: The Lord is the True Master; True is His justice. He arranges and beholds all His plays.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaad kahai jan naanak har sache ke gun gaae ||5||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, servant Nanak speaks and sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਕੋ ਜਾਣਸੀ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਦਰਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daravesee ko jaanasee viralaa ko daraves ||
lines.translation: How rare is the dervish, the Saintly renunciate, who understands renunciation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਹੰਢੈ ਮੰਗਦਾ ਧਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਧਿਗੁ ਵੇਸੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: je ghar ghar ha(n)dhai ma(n)gadaa dhig jeevan dhig ves ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the life, and cursed are the clothes, of one who wanders around, begging from door to door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਆਸਾ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਤਜਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je aasaa a(n)desaa taj rahai guramukh bhikhiaa naau ||
lines.translation: But, if he abandons hope and anxiety, and as Gurmukh receives the Name as his charity,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਪਖਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tis ke charan pakhaaleeahi naanak hau balihaarai jaau ||1||
lines.translation: then Nanak washes his feet, and is a sacrifice to him. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰਵਰੁ ਏਕੁ ਫਲੁ ਦੁਇ ਪੰਖੇਰੂ ਆਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak taravar ek phal dui pa(n)kheroo aahi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the tree has one fruit, but two birds are perched upon it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਵਤ ਜਾਤ ਨ ਦੀਸਹੀ ਨਾ ਪਰ ਪੰਖੀ ਤਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: aavat jaat na deesahee naa par pa(n)khee taahi ||
lines.translation: They are not seen coming or going; these birds have no wings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਰਸ ਭੋਗਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu ra(n)gee ras bhogiaa sabad rahai nirabaan ||
lines.translation: One enjoys so many pleasures, while the other, through the Word of the Shabad, remains in Nirvaanaa.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਫਲਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har ras phal raate naanakaa karam sachaa neesaan ||2||
lines.translation: Imbued with the subtle essence of the fruit of the Lord's Name, O Nanak, the soul bears the True Insignia of God's Grace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਧਰਤੀ ਆਪੇ ਹੈ ਰਾਹਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਜੰਮਾਇ ਪੀਸਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape dharatee aape hai raahak aap ja(n)maai peesaavai ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the field, and He Himself is the farmer. He Himself grows and grinds the corn.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਪਕਾਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਂਡੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਰੋਸੈ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਬਹਿ ਖਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap pakaavai aap bhaa(n)de dei parosai aape hee bahi khaavai ||
lines.translation: He Himself cooks it, He Himself puts the food in the dishes, and He Himself sits down to eat.
